notes.title: Patch #6: The Achievements Update
notes.notes:
[p]Greetings Commander,

The latest update has been released: [b]Release v1.1.0d - Achievements  

[/b]In today's patch we’ve introduced 38 new Steam Achievements, organized into six categories: Exalted Feats, Covenants, Voidcraft, Dominion, Stratagems, Massacre, and Hosts of War. These challenges are designed to push you to approach Void War in fresh ways, adding new layers of depth and replayability to the experience you already know.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44923838/d4ef646836f50d5278f812195e780ba6f89ba68f.png"][/img][/p][h2]Retroactive Achievements[/h2][p]Some but not all Achievements will be retroactive, meaning the game can check your Archives data and automatically complete Achievements whose data can be verified in your past runs. Unfortunately most Achievements rely on data that was never stored in past versions of the game, so those will have to be completed in v1.1.0d or later.[/p][p][/p][h2]Additional Changes[/h2][p]We’ve also rolled out the usual round of UI improvements, bug fixes, and balance adjustments inspired by player feedback. The new Dismiss Crew button makes it simple to clear unwanted crew from your ship, particularly handy when chasing the Covenant achievements. The commander and ship selection menus now provide detailed tracking of victories by commander and Torment level. Poison mechanics have also been refined: higher stacks now deal damage more rapidly, so piling on massive poison will drain enemy life far faster than before. Several underpowered units have been strengthened: Imperial Marshals now deal double damage in burning rooms, while Blood Golems have gained the ability to raise Thralls.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]Version Number: Release 1.1.0d[/b][/h2][h3][b]Content[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Added 38 Steam Achievements[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Stability[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed husks and other crew rewards lingering in the background after not being picked during choice rewards (added during Beta)[/p][/*][*][p]Provisional fix for rare Starflayer wave attack crash (added during Beta)[/p][/*][*][p]Provisional fix for rare Summon Hound crash (added during Beta)[/p][/*][*][p]Provisional fix for delayed crew death from ranged attacks (added during Beta)[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed rare crew stuck bug from enemy crew spawner spawning past capacity (added during Beta)[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Gameplay[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Added ‘Dismiss Crew’ button (added during Beta)[/p][/*][*][p]Poison damage applies faster when stacked above 10, 20, and 30[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced Imperial Enforcer buy price[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced Imperial Marshal buy price[/p][/*][*][p]Added "double DPS in rooms on fire" and fire immunity to Imperial Marshal[/p][/*][*][p]Increased Corsair DPS[/p][/*][*][p]Added Raise Thrall ability to Blood Golem[/p][/*][*][p]Increased Death Knight buy price[/p][/*][*][p]Increased Assault Cyborg buy price[/p][/*][*][p]Increased Conqueror buy price[/p][/*][*][p]Increased Gene Soldier DPS[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced Death Cultist buy price[/p][/*][*][p]Increased Death Mage HP[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]UI[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Victories on Normal difficulty are now displayed in the ship select menu (added during Beta)[/p][/*][*][p]Added Victorious Commanders indicator to ship select (added during Beta) [/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Text[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed Carnivore Hatch description (added during Beta)[/p][/*][/list][p]

[/p]

notes.title: Patch #5: The Doomweaver Update
notes.notes:
[p]Greetings Commander,
[/p][p]The latest update has been released: [b]Release v1.0.5 - Doomweaver

[/b]This patch introduces the brand new 13th commander to Void War. We originally planned to commit to 12 commanders, but we ended up having so many ideas that more than 12 was pretty much inevitable. [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44923838/4f21038cb40f8cf2206f1f7a93c8a46b0c4ae3b1.png"][/img][/p][p]The first of these new commanders is the [b]Doomweaver[/b]. She is a powerful battle-psyker with a once-per-fight spell that has two different effects depending on how you cast it: 

[b]Threads of Ruin[/b] - If manning Command Throne, instantly kill the highest HP crew in target room. Otherwise teleport to target room and deal 15 HP damage to hostile crew.[/p][p][/p][h2]Achievements Beta[/h2][p]Today’s update also brings us a preview beta version of the next update, [b]Release v1.1.0,[/b] which will include the 38 new [b]Steam Achievements[/b] that some of you may have already seen in the Steam interface. We could use some help testing these achievements, so if you want to participate be sure to check out the [b]beta discussion channel [/b]on Discord: [/p][p][url="https://discord.com/channels/1205970613173354638/1387542180335190186"]https://discord.com/channels/1205970613173354638/1387542180335190186[/url][/p][p] [b] [/b][/p][p]Void War beta builds are open to all players and can be accessed at any time in Steam.

1. In Steam, right-click Void War > Properties > Betas 
2. Next to Beta Participation > select “beta - public testing for steam players”[/p][p][/p][p]Note that beta builds will be more prone to bugs than release builds. If you have any issues please post a bug report on the Discord and we’ll get you sorted out.[/p][p]
[/p][h2][b]Version Number: Release 1.0.5[/b][/h2][h3][b]Content[/b][/h3][list][*][p]New commander: Doomweaver[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Stability[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed Stygian Worm crashing game when not present aboard ship while attempting to spawn Tentacle[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Gameplay[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Added ‘Dismiss Crew’ button[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]UI[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Display hull name in upgrade menu[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed incorrect name generators on some commanders[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Patch #4: The Bellerophon Update
notes.notes:
[p]Greetings Commander,
[/p][p]The latest update has been released: [b]Release v1.0.4b - Bellerophon

[/b]Today's patch comes with the powerful new variant of Light Destroyer known as [i]Bellerophon[/i]. Forced to flee mid-construction by the arrival of an Imperial purgation fleet, the half-finished [i]Bellerophon[/i] nonetheless carries such advanced systems and armaments that observers believe its combat potential rivals or even surpasses that of any known warship.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44923838/e32c43e211704c63bbfa0d355e4ae62ab6958322.png"][/img][/p][p]In addition to the new ship, we've also included a few provisional fixes for several recurring bugs that have been present since launch, notably the profile corruption bug (the one that wipes your save and prevents you from launching the game entirely). This latest version of Void War should be able to detect profile corruption, and instead of crashing immediately it will attempt to load a backup or simply create a new profile and notify you of the corruption. 

As always, if you have lost progress due to profile corruption, you can always post a bug report in the Discord and we will happy to reconstruct your profile for you. Thanks for your patience. 

Lastly, we have a few random fixes and tweaks: Seeker Missiles felt a bit overtuned so that needed a change, more nuanced rules for recalling permanent AI-controlled friendly crew, and an in-game Announcements menu which will be useful for posting patch notes and any other important updates. notes.title: Patch #1: The Profane Ecstasy Update
notes.notes:
[p]Greetings Commander, [/p][p]The first post-launch content update has been released: [b]Release v1.0.1 - Profane Ecstasy [/b][/p][p][/p][p]It features two new ships. The first one is Overseer C, a[i] [/i]Blood Cult pleasure craft named [i]Profane Ecstasy[/i]. Equipped with a Thrall Pit, Terminus Bands, and an Enslaved Fiend stalking its corridors, the [i]Profane Ecstasy [/i]presents a terrifying foe for the enemies of Ariok. If you've ever wanted to throw exploding demonic flesh babies at your enemies, now's your chance. [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44923838/f82fb2fafa8ec8b59626a342f6094dbfd3c42182.png"][/img][/p][p]The second new ship is Light Destroyer A, [i]Ultima Ratio.[/i] A relatively new pattern of starship constructed by Imperial defectors, [i]Ultima Ratio[/i], forgoes boarding capability for massive ship-to-ship alpha strike potential. Outfitted with the rare logic engine known as [i]Wrath of Angels[/i], it ensures lance weapons achieve unerring target lock in all combat conditions. [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44923838/022ca680fe18287be27422f9a2999b2cc3716212.png"][/img][/p][p]In addition to these new ships, the Profane Ecstasy Update contains a host of balance changes and reworks to existing ships, weapons, items, and commanders. We're excited to see how you adapt with these newly revised tools. [/p][p]
This patch took a bit longer than usual due to the need to implement cross-version autosave compatibility, something that wasn't present during the Backer Alpha. We also used the extra time to address a wave of bugs and balance issues based on the excellent feedback from our community. Moving forward, we hope to resume our previous cadence of roughly 2 patches per month. 
[/p][p]Ok, onto patch notes!  [/p][h3]

notes.title: Steam Launch Delayed!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, we have a problem.  The Steam release has been delayed 😩 

We ran into an issue with the Steam release approval process. Every single indicator in the Release Progress dashboard suggested that the release was set for noon May 30th, 2025. Unfortunately there is apparently an extra layer of Steam review that is required before Steam releases the game. We are going through this final process now and have been told it will take 3-5 days. We’ll keep you posted on further news. Sorry about the wait!

-morph

notes.title: This Warhammer 40k-inspired indie game truly is a grimdark FTL, and I'm hooked
notes.notes:
Reader, I'm in trouble. Void War is really, really good. That's good news for the two-person indie development team Tundra, who may be about to make lots and lots of money. But it's bad news for me, an ADHD-afflicted games writer with a lifelong obsession for Warhammer 40,000 and poor impulse control, because Void War has me down bad.

Read the rest of the story...

notes.title: Void War is now available to download on Itch!
notes.notes:
DOWNLOAD: https://tundra-interactive.itch.io/void-war

(If the itch.io link doesn't work you can google "void war itch" and it's the first result)
--

Hey everyone,

Void War is now available on Itch.io in Alpha. We're doing the Alpha on Itch to fix bugs, gather feedback, and polish the game up before the Steam launch. If you purchase the Alpha on Itch, not only will you get to [b]play the game right now[/b], you will also be able to transfer your Itch version to Steam when we eventually release there.

In other news, we have just updated our Steam page with the full trailer for Void War. If you haven't seen the new trailer yet, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2853590/Void_War/?beta=1]you can head over to the Steam page right now and check it out[/url]. We wanted to showcase just how extensively we are re-imagining the space roguelite format and what exactly the dark techno-gothic setting does for this kind of game.

For those of you who prefer reading, here's where we took it:
[list]
[*] Powerful, customizable commander units, each with their own unique abilities
[*] SIGNIFICANTLY more emphasis on crew combat and boarding actions, with over 70 different crew types, each with their own unique characteristics including passive/active abilities, resistances, and equipment slots.
[*] Over 140 different types of wargear to outfit your crew, including weapons, armor, consumable, and psychic powers, all of which have the potential to drastically alter the performance of each individual unit.
[*] Multiple bosses
[*] A streamlined map interface that focuses on strategic decision-making. Say goodbye to the days of having your run tanked by forgetting to double-check pathing decisions on the star map. Points of interest such as merchants and repair points are telegraphed in advance so you can always plan your route with maximum tactical awareness.
[*] Weird and grim techno-artifacts such as:
[*] ...DEMON LANCE: Drains the life force of all crew aboard your ship (both friend and foe) and uses it to supercharge your starship's lance weapons 
[*] ...CORPSE EFFIGY: Infuses your poison abilities with spectral torpor, halving the repair speed of affected crew 
[*] ...HATE MATRIX: Makes all of your crew's non-lethal spells lethal using the power of HATE
[*] 12 Torment difficulties (for now) which will gradually ramp up the variety and challenge. We want to see you reach your peak potential as the last sane commander in a galaxy gone mad. 
[*] And of course the usual weapons, shields, and life support systems you'd expect to find on a starship, but also displacement weapons, graviton field generators, profane altars to the dark gods, and more...
[/list]
If any of this sounds exciting to you, you can pick up the Alpha version of Void War right now on[url=https://tundra-interactive.itch.io/void-war] Itch.io[/url].
